categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Realsun Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemicals industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of pharmaceutical intermediates, pesticide intermediates, and electronic chemicals. The company has diversified into fine chemicals, electronic chemicals, and biodegradable new materials, serving sectors such as pharmaceuticals, agriculture, electronics, cosmetics, semiconductors, and lithium batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced continuous production technologies including dehydrogenation-hydrogenation cycling, alkali metal safe continuous automated production, ultra-pure chemical preparation, trace impurity removal, and metal ion control. It utilizes DCS system control for full-line automation and digital management, with patented technologies in continuous flow production and reaction distillation. The production emphasizes green, low-carbon, and intelligent manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading pharmaceutical, pesticide, and electronic chemical manufacturers and traders, such as Bayer Group and Laurus Labs. The products serve end markets in pharmaceuticals (including anti-HIV drugs), agriculture (pesticides), electronics (semiconductors, displays, solar cells), cosmetics, and lithium battery electrolytes. The company maintains a mix of domestic and international customers, with a focus on high-end, differentiated product applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Zhejiang (Taizhou, Linhai), Jiangxi (Leping), Hebei (Cangzhou), and Zhejiang (Zhoushan). It serves both domestic and overseas markets, with about 62% of sales domestic and 38% international. The company exports products globally and maintains international cooperation and certifications.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Realsun Chemical is positioned in the midstream of the chemical supply chain, producing fine chemical intermediates and specialty chemicals used by downstream pharmaceutical, pesticide, and electronics manufacturers. It controls its own procurement, production, and sales, and also engages in import-export trade, acting as both manufacturer and distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on key product development, technology breakthroughs, and enhancing core competitiveness through differentiated products. R&D efforts target electronic chemicals, biodegradable new materials, and pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates. It collaborates with universities and research institutes, holds numerous patents, and invests in digital transformation and green manufacturing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of fine chemical products, including self-produced pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates, electronic chemicals, and trade products. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to end customers and supplemented by trade through intermediaries. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a top 100 domestic specialty fine chemical high-tech enterprise and a national 'specialized and innovative' small giant. It holds industry leadership in several product segments with advanced technology and quality standards. Competitors include multinational chemical companies and domestic peers in fine chemicals, but Zhejiang Realsun differentiates itself through continuous innovation, automation, and a diversified product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 632 million, a 4.47% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 17.3 million, down 75.73%. Total assets were about RMB 1.69 billion, with stable asset base and ongoing investment in capacity expansion projects. The company is in a growth phase with strategic investments in new product lines and production upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Realsun Chemical emphasizes high product purity (up to 99.999%), advanced continuous and automated production processes, and strong R&D capabilities to deliver differentiated, high-value fine chemicals. Its products meet stringent quality and environmental standards, supported by multiple patents and certifications. The company offers customized solutions tailored to customer needs, enhancing customer loyalty and market share in high-end chemical segments.
